## Frequently asked questions

### How do I install sprezzature-ui?

Run pip install sprezzature-ui (Python 3.10 or newer): one install brings the i18n audit, the catalogue tools, the sprezzature-ui command, the API (Application Programming Interface, web addresses another program sends a request to and gets an answer from) served over HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol, the way a browser asks a server for a page), and the MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol through which AI agents call tools in English) server, with no extras to choose. The interface-writing half is the skill: pip install sprezzature then sprezzature-skills --install , or sprezzature-skills --install --agent opencode for OpenCode.

### What kind of code does sprezzature-ui produce?

sprezzature-ui guides an agent to write semantic HTML, Tailwind utility classes and plain ES (ECMAScript, the standard behind JavaScript) modules, files that load one another by name, with no React, Vue or other framework runtime. Dark-mode variants, visible focus rings and reduced-motion guards are on by default, and the type follows the three-Roboto rule: Roboto, Roboto Serif and Roboto Mono, self-hosted, unless you name another typeface.

### Can I use sprezzature-ui without Claude Code?

Partly: sprezzature-ui's i18n tools run on their own as a Python library, a command line, an HTTP API with a Docker image and an MCP server, sprezzature-ui-mcp . Writing the interface itself is the model's job, guided by the skill and the prose in its references/ folder, so that half needs an agent such as Claude Code or OpenCode.

### What does the sprezzature-ui audit check, and can it run in CI?

sprezzature-ui's audit, sprezzature-ui-i18n-audit , flags translation tables embedded in JavaScript or HTML (rule I18N001 ) and LLM (large language model, the kind of AI behind ChatGPT) prompts inlined in Python as constants named like PROMPT or INSTRUCTION (rule I18N002 ). It exits 1 on any finding, so it can fail a CI job or run as the pre-commit hook the repository declares; it does not judge whether a translation is good.

### How does sprezzature-ui handle translations in YAML?

sprezzature-ui keeps every translatable string, interface labels and model prompts alike, in one catalogue, locales/i18n.yaml . sprezzature-ui-i18n-make scaffolds it, compiles it to locales/i18n.json and writes two loaders, locales/i18n.js for the browser and locales/i18n_prompts.py for Python; sprezzature-ui-i18n-audit --fix moves strings it finds into the catalogue and prints the call to paste, without rewriting your code.

### Does sprezzature-ui send my code to a cloud service?

No: sprezzature-ui's audit and catalogue tools read your files locally, with no network and no model, so Ollama is not needed; the audit imports only the Python standard library. The interface code itself is written by your agent, which follows its own provider's data policy.

### How is sprezzature-ui different from shadcn/ui, v0 or Bootstrap?

shadcn/ui hands you React components and Bootstrap ships a broad component library, while sprezzature-ui refuses any framework runtime and offers written rules plus a handful of components to copy. v0 builds an application from a prompt inside a hosted account; sprezzature-ui works with the agent you already run and checks the result with deterministic audits.

### Is sprezzature-ui free?

Yes. sprezzature-ui is open source under the BSD (Berkeley Software Distribution, a University of California licence that lets anyone use, change or sell the code as long as the copyright notice stays) 3-Clause licence, with no account, API key or paid tier, and its source is on GitHub .

# Laws of UX — Sprezzature

Source: https://sprezzature.ai/ux-laws.html

sprezzature-ux-laws

# Laws of user experience (UX)

Apply the canonical Laws of UX (Jon YABLONSKI) to vanilla-JavaScript (JS) + Tailwind: both when making new user interface (UI) and when auditing existing HyperText Markup Language (HTML). Reference covers 30 laws with trigger / action / Tailwind hook.

SKILL.md (the agent spec)
⭐ on GitHub

## Makes

Design a screen with Hick / Fitts / Miller / Peak-End in mind

Each law paired with a concrete Tailwind hook

## Audits

Static auditor flags the mechanically-detectable subset: Hick, Miller, Fitts, Jakob, Tesler, Aesthetic-Usability, Selective Attention, Choice Overload (eight checks)

Severity + JavaScript Object Notation (JSON, a text format in which programs store data as named fields) output for pre-commit / continuous integration (CI, the server that re-runs a project's checks on every change)

## Say one of these

The skill triggers itself on phrasing like this, no command to memorize.

audit for Laws of UX
design this screen using Hick / Fitts
is my nav too Hick-heavy
too many choices
cognitive load
Doherty threshold
reduce clutter

## Reference library

The 30 laws

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I install sprezzature-ux-laws?

Run pip install sprezzature-ux-laws on Python 3.10 or later: one install gives the library, both commands, the API (Application Programming Interface, web addresses another program sends a request to and gets an answer from) served over HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol, the way a browser asks a server for a page), and the MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol through which AI agents call tools in English) server, with no extras to choose. sprezzature-ux-laws is free and open source under the BSD (Berkeley Software Distribution, a University of California licence that lets anyone use, change or sell the code as long as the copyright notice stays) 3-Clause licence.

### Which Laws of UX does sprezzature-ux-laws check?

sprezzature-ux-laws checks eight of the thirty laws on lawsofux.com, the ones a scan of the HTML source can decide: hick , choice-overload , miller , jakob , fitts , aesthetic-usability , selective-attention and tesler . Two of them, hick and jakob , are errors and the other six are warnings; --only and --ignore pick among them by slug.

### What does sprezzature-ux-laws --fix change?

sprezzature-ux-laws repairs four laws with --fix : it adds min-h-11 for Fitts, a focus-visible:ring-2 focus ring for aesthetic-usability, splits long codes into groups of four with non-breaking spaces for Miller, and rewrites a clickable div or span into a real button for Jakob. The other four need a design decision, not a text edit. --fix --dry-run previews the edits, and a second run on a repaired file applies none.

### How does sprezzature-ux-laws count choices on a responsive menu?

sprezzature-ux-laws counts what one screen shows, not every link in the file: it resolves each control's visibility from its Tailwind display classes and reports the worse of the phone count and the desktop count, so a desktop row and a hamburger menu are not added together. A details , a dialog , a menu or a group such as a tablist counts as one choice, and a nav with more than seven choices on one screen is a Hick's Law error.

### Does sprezzature-ux-laws send my pages to a cloud service?

No: sprezzature-ux-laws reads the raw HTML with Python's standard-library parser, with no browser, no network and no AI model, so it needs nothing besides pip. That keeps it deterministic and fast enough for a pre-commit hook.

### How is sprezzature-ux-laws different from Lighthouse or a design review?

sprezzature-ux-laws reads source only, so it catches the mechanical, source-decidable mistakes without a browser, but it cannot render a page or watch a person use it. Lighthouse with field data measures response time, the Doherty threshold this tool explicitly leaves out, and a design review or a session with real users is still what tells you whether a screen makes sense; this tool exists so the mechanical faults never reach that review.

### Can I run sprezzature-ux-laws in CI?

Yes: sprezzature-ux-laws exits 1 when sprezzature-ux-laws site/ finds at least one error, or any finding at all with --strict , and exits 2 on a usage error. --json prints one object per finding, with the law, severity, path, line, message and snippet, for a CI job to read.

### Can I use sprezzature-ux-laws without Claude Code?

Yes: sprezzature-ux-laws is a Python library ( audit_html , audit_file , fix_file ), a command line, an HTTP API with a Docker image that runs sprezzature-ux-laws-mcp , and an MCP server whose tools are health , list_laws and audit_interface . The agent skill that tells Claude Code or OpenCode when to apply the laws comes with pip install sprezzature , then sprezzature-skills --install .

---

# Video claims — Sprezzature

Source: https://sprezzature.ai/video.html

sprezzature-video

# Video claims

A README gets re-read. A number burned into a keyframe does not. This package holds a film’s assertions against the code they describe, in both directions, and answers whether the film can be rendered again at all from a clean clone.

SKILL.md (the agent spec)
⭐ on GitHub

## Makes

WebVTT from the narration script and the measured length of each audio file, not from a transcript and not typed by hand

A poster baked as frame zero, because Slack, X and Discord regenerate their thumbnail server-side from the first frame whatever a poster= attribute says

Loudness normalised across a series, so one film is not louder than the next

## Audits

verify — every declared claim against the file that would have to change for it to stop being true

scan — every number visible on screen that no claim accounts for, because the dangerous claim is the undeclared one

pitch — problem, then solution, then underlying magic, in Guy KAWASAKI’s order, with a feature list refused where an insight belongs

assets — can this film be rendered again from a clone? Tracked, derived, or exists in exactly one place

prose — the on-screen writing against the project’s charter, one finding per line

## Say one of these

The skill triggers itself on phrasing like this, no command to memorize.

make a launch video
the demo video is out of date
verify the claims in this video
re-cut the film
is this number still right
can we rebuild this video
poster frame

## Reference library

The knowledge the skill draws on: read them straight from the repo.

Where it stops
Every trigger phrase

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I install sprezzature-video?

Run pip install sprezzature-video (Python 3.10 to 3.13): the command line, the API (Application Programming Interface, web addresses another program sends a request to and gets an answer from) served over HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol, the way a browser asks a server for a page), and the MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol through which AI agents call tools in English) server install with it, with no extra to choose. The command is sprezzature-video , also spelled make-film .

### What does sprezzature-video need besides pip?

sprezzature-video needs only ffmpeg on PATH : poster and the loudness functions call it, and captions measures each narration audio file through ffprobe, which ships with ffmpeg. It runs no model, needs no GPU (graphics processing unit, the chip that draws a screen) and calls no network service; verify , scan , prose , pitch and calque read text files and nothing else.

### What is a claim in sprezzature-video?

In sprezzature-video, a claim is a fact a film states on screen, declared in the film's YAML (YAML Ain't Markup Language, a plain-text settings format of indented name: value lines) spec as a pair: the text with its value, and the file in the project that decides it, read by one of five methods ( json_len , json_key_len , regex_count , line_count , literal ). A missing source file fails the claim instead of skipping it, so a count that moves in the code fails the check instead of quietly ageing the film.

### What do verify, scan, assets and captions check in sprezzature-video?

In sprezzature-video, verify checks every declared claim against its file, scan lists the numbers visible in an HTML composition that no claim accounts for, and assets , the asset ledger, says whether each file the film renders from is tracked, derived or held in one place only, which decides whether a clone can render it again. captions writes WebVTT from the narration script and the measured length of each audio file, without transcribing anything.

### How is sprezzature-video different from linting a video script?

sprezzature-video reads the project a film describes, not only its words: verify fails a number on screen when the code behind it changes, even if the script never did. It lints the script too, with prose (dashes, banned phrases, sentences opening on a negation, in English and French), and scan catches what a lint cannot see, a number typed into a keyframe that nobody declared.

### Can I use sprezzature-video without Claude Code?

Yes: sprezzature-video is also a Python library ( import sprezzature_video ), a command line, an HTTP API with a Docker image, and an MCP server, sprezzature-video-mcp , serving the API and /mcp on one port. The HTTP and MCP surfaces cover verify , scan and captions ; the skill comes from pip install sprezzature then sprezzature-skills --install , or sprezzature-skills --install --agent opencode .

### Can I run sprezzature-video in CI?

Yes: every sprezzature-video command exits 0 when the film is still honest, 1 when it is not (a claim that fails, a number nobody declared, an asset not in hand) and 2 on a wrong call or a missing ffmpeg, so sprezzature-video verify film.yaml --root . can fail a pull request. sprezzature-video prose script.txt --strict is made for a pre-commit hook.

### Is sprezzature-video free?

Yes: sprezzature-video is open source under the BSD (Berkeley Software Distribution, a University of California licence that lets anyone use, change or sell the code as long as the copyright notice stays) 3-Clause licence, with no account, API key or paid tier, and its source is on GitHub . It is still alpha, and it renders nothing itself: the films are made with Hyperframes, outside the package.
